answer_1.quote: AMR-to-text generation is the task of recovering a text with the same meaning as a given Abstract Meaning Representation (AMR) ... As input we use an English-centric AMR graph where the output y can be realized in different languages.
answer_1.outputs: multilingual text sentences generated from AMR graphs

answer_2.quote: The models are evaluated in the multilingual LDC2020T07 test set, using BLEU, METEOR, chrF++ and BERTscore metrics.
